DIESEL stress-tested as simultaneous wars target refineries

Global prices for diesel and other middle distillates remain close to record highs in real terms as simultaneous conflicts in the Middle East and Russia continue to disrupt refinery operations and export routes.

The wars have become increasingly interconnected, damaging some refineries, while leaving others unable to maintain normal output because they cannot source enough crude and other feedstocks, or export fuels they have produced.

Global refinery capacity has been effectively reduced by as much as 10%, according to some estimates, creating an acute shortage of fuels, rapid depletion of inventories, and intense upward pressure on prices ...

UKMTO has received a report of an incident 25NM Northeast of Khasab, Oman in the Strait of Hormuz. A third-party has reported that a tanker transiting outbound is on fire, the cause is unknown at time of report. Status of crew, damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at present.

Update 001: UKMTO has received a verified report confirming the crew are safe, and there is no environmental impact. The report indicates that the tanker was approached on the port side by a small boat which attached two explosive devices to the hull above the waterline. The subsequent blasts resulted in a fire in the engine room which temporarily disabled the vessel. The fire is now reported as extinguished and vessel is continuing to its next port of call. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities
